lista.titulo: Air and missile defence systems
lista.concurso: 2nd call for proposals for common procurement actions under the Programme
lista.objetivo: This topic aims at actions supporting the common procurement of integrated, multilayered, air and missile defence, or parts thereof including sensors (e.g. radars), kinetic or non-kinetic effectors, command and control, that protects against the full spectrum of air threats (cruise missiles, ballistic and hypersonic missiles, aircraft and UAS) from medium to long range, high and terminal high altitude, including endo-atmospheric interceptor. This topic does not cover very short to short range air defence systems against low altitude UAS (covered by call topic EDIP-P-2026-FNLC-CPA-CDS).

lista.titulo: Maturing projects for possible future European Defence Projects of Common Interest and preparing their implementation roadmap
lista.concurso: Call for proposals for coordination and support actions for potential future European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCIs) under the Programme
lista.objetivo: This topic aims to support the maturation of forming collaborative projects towards possible future European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCI) and the preparation of their implementation roadmap for the period 2028-2034.

lista.titulo: Ground and naval platforms and systems
lista.concurso: 2nd call for proposals for common procurement actions under the Programme
lista.objetivo: This topic aims to support the common procurement of a wide range of capabilities or systems of ground and naval platforms or parts thereof, including but not limited to artillery systems, (counter)-mobility platforms, tanks or other armoured vehicles, support vehicles, combat platforms, soldier systems, surface and underwater naval platforms or their sub-systems.

lista.titulo: Support for the functioning of SEAPs, including for the purpose of establishing, managing and maintaining defence industrial readiness pools
lista.concurso: Continuous call for proposals for supporting actions under the Programme
lista.objetivo: This call aims to provide support for functioning of established SEAPs, including for the purpose of establishing, managing and maintaining defence industrial readiness pools.

lista.entidadeNome: EUSPA-RP-23-26 - “PRIM – Prototype for GNSS Radio-Frequency Interference Monitoring”
lista.titulo: EUSPA-RP-23-26 - “PRIM – Prototype for GNSS Radio-Frequency Interference Monitoring”
lista.objetivo: Increasing levels of GNSS radio-frequency interference (RFI) affecting satellite navigation users and infrastructures have highlighted the need for enhanced monitoring capabilities at European level. The procurement aims at concluding a direct contract for the design, development, demonstration, deployment and maintenance/support of a GNSS RFI monitoring prototype, integrating multiple data providers (open, commercial, and EU-owned) and multiple data sources (terrestrial and space) to detect GNSS RFI events and identify suspected RFI sources.
